snippet.description:
On December 4th, our indigenous cultural heritage ‘jang-making culture in the Republic of Korea’ has been inscribed on UNESCO’s Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

Artisan who carries it forward with authenticity
Artisan who carries it forward with a modern touch
